name: FortiManager Orchestrator
description: This integration enables orchestration between Fortigate's FortiManager and Keyfactor's services.,

store_types.Name: FortiManager

Properties.Name: SyncFortigateDevice
Properties.Description: Set to true if you want to push any modifications automatically to the managed Fortigate device.  Set to false if you only want to make modifications on the FortiManager device and sync later.

Properties.Name: ServerUsername
Properties.Description: User ID for the FortiManager instance you are managing.

Properties.Name: ServerPassword
Properties.Description: Password for the FortiManager instance you are managing

Properties.Name: ServerUseSsl
Properties.Description: Not Used.  Required field in the Keyfactor Command UI, but not used by this integration.

store_types.ClientMachineDescription: The IP address or DNS of the FortiManager server
store_types.StorePathDescription: Value must contain the the FortiManager ADOM, FortiManager device name, and Fortigate VDOM this certificate store will be managing using the pipe character as a delimiter.  For example - root|Device1|root
